root_text:
🚨 India reports its first case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in an 8-month-old baby in Bangalore. 🚨

HMPV, previously seen in China—could this be another outbreak like COVID-19? Experts are watching closely.

Should we be worried? 🤔
#HMPV
